***1. State Level Award***

_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a registered artisan or weaver, or an industry registered as Handloom Weaver/Handicraftsman under the Directorate of Industries, Uttarakhand, or the Development Commissioner (Handicrafts/Handloom), Government of India. 1. The applicant must be an individual artisan or weaver belonging to a registered handicraft or handloom cooperative society, or a registered non-governmental organization (NGO) within the state of Uttarakhand to be eligible for the award. 1. The artisan’s/weaver’s cooperative society or institution must not be a loan defaulter with any department or bank. 1. An artisan/weaver who has already received an award cannot apply again for the next three consecutive years.
